text:
tara: Heads-up 
I opened a PR to add Eastern Europe (eu-east-1) to the availability matrix and to clarify residency for embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601
oscar: Great. Support asked that we explicitly list which plans have in-region embeddings storage, otherwise customers keep opening tickets.
tara: Draft line I added in the PR:
```
Eastern Europe (eu-east-1): Supported. Dedicated and Private deployments can request in-region storage for embeddings and request-level data handling. Hosted availability depends on plan tier; contact support for residency add-on options (subject to contract).
```
mei: Legal asked to avoid the phrase "request-level data handling" in public docs

They prefer: "data processing options available upon request". Also add a short note that "embeddings stored in-region are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys for Private deployments" if applicable.
tara: OK I'll swap that wording. I won't mention KMS specifics except in the Private page.
mei: Also, small ask from infra: update the SDK snippet to use the canonical header. We deprecated "X-Region-Old" earlier; it still appears in the migration docs.
ioscar: I'll update snippets. Proposed curl + node examples:
```
# curl sample
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-east-1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-emb-1","input":"hello"}'
\n// node (fetch)
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-east-1',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({model: 'rwd-emb-1', input: 'hello'})
});
```
mei: Nice. Make sure the migration note mentions the old header name and the deprecation timeline: "X-Region-Old was deprecated 2025-01-15; clients should move to X-Redwood-Region."
tara: Good call. I'll add a one-liner in the migration section and link to /docs/migrate-region-headers\.
Note: link-checker previously flagged that page as moved to /docs/migrate-headers, so I will point to /docs/migrate-headers instead.
docs-bot: Link-check failed on /docs/migrate-region-headers (404) 

oscar: We should also add a tiny troubleshooting blurb: If you see 422 for embedding creation in eu-east-1, it may be because region quota isn't provisioned; advise customers to open a support ticket.
mei: Also add an internal note for Dedicated customers: "If you need guaranteed in-country residency for embeddings in eu-east-1, request residency during provisioning; there may be lead time."
tara: I'll include that under a short FAQ item in the PR. Can someone do a quick copy pass for tone? I'm heading into interviews in 20. :coffee:
ioscar: I can do it after lunch. Adding i18n-needed label so localization is aware.
docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #601 
tara: Thanks all. Once legal is happy with the exact phrasing I'll merge and schedule the translation job.
mei: Legal, quick approval?
infra-bot: Automated note: region eu-east-1 resource pool is ready for Dedicated onboarding.
mei: Legal reviewed and suggested the phrasing: "Data processing options available upon request for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted plans may store embeddings outside the country depending on tier; contact support for options (subject to contract)."
tara: Applied legal wording and updated the migration link target. Tagging @docs-bot for final CI run. :sparkles:
